title: Will LLMs Sink or Swim? Exploring Decision-Making Under Pressure

live_model.evidence: 'GPT-3.5-Turbo (GPT-3.5-turbo-0125), and GPT-4o (GPT-4o-2024-05-13) for our experiments, with a temperature setting of 0.1' (Section 4.2)

prompt.location: Appendix C.1 Tables 10-11 (explicit pressure prompts) and C.2 (implicit scenario prompts); standard GSE/ES/PRCA scales

claim.metric: General Self-Efficacy scale score (baseline, no pressure)
claim.location: Table 2, column GPT-4o, row Base (GSE 31.36, ES 5.63); PRCA without persona 40.84

data.source: prompts printed in the appendix; public psychometric scales

notes: Repetitions per condition (10 for GPT models) and item counts make n_items unclear; outputs are Likert responses.

resolution.plan: n resolves from Sec. 4.2: GPT models were run 10 times per prompt and placement, so the no-pressure baseline is 10 administrations of the 10-item General Self-Efficacy scale (Schwarzer and Jerusalem 1995, public; 4-point Likert, total 10-40). Send the 10 items with a Likert answer-format line to gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at temperature 0.1, repeat 10 times, average the totals and compare with 31.36 (Table 2, GPT-4o Base).
resolution.approximation: The exact baseline instruction for the Likert format is not printed (Tables 10-12 hold only the pressure prompts), so a minimal format instruction is written; item order follows the published scale.
